_comment: Book 11, Chapter 10's normalized result taxonomy for the Zero Trust Assessment. The status values and skip reasons are those in the tool's 3.1.0 source (Get-ZtTestStatus.ps1; Add-ZtTestResultDetail.ps1's SkippedBecause set; Get-ZtSkippedReason.ps1), read at tag 3.1.0 on November 11, 2026. The mapping is versioned with the tool: an export from another version is still normalized, but the summary says the mapping hasn't been reviewed for that version. A status or skip reason not listed here becomes Unable-to-Evaluate with unmapped: true, never a pass or a failure.

Investigate.note: A finding that needs manual review before it is confirmed or dismissed (Book 11, Chapter 10)

Error.note: The tool couldn't evaluate the test; fix the run and re-run

reviewReasons.NotDotGovDomain: The tool found no .gov domain; for a federal tenant, check the tenant's verified domains before accepting the skip

dispositions.Planned: Ignore until the tool implements the test
dispositions.Skipped-Licensing: A licensing decision: record whether the license applies in the boundary; not a failed control (Book 11, Chapter 10)
dispositions.Skipped-Disconnected: Fix the run's scope, connections or roles and re-run
dispositions.Skipped-Not-Applicable: Record the reason; a feature unsupported where the tool runs, or in a government cloud, is a boundary finding (Book 10)
dispositions.Unable-to-Evaluate: Fix the run, or verify by hand and record the manual result

cisaPillars._comment: Design guidance: the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model pillar each tool pillar is filed under. Security Operations maps to the cross-cutting Visibility and Analytics capability, which has no pillar of its own.

scoring._comment: The kit's default for Book 11, Chapter 10's severity, priority and buckets (design guidance, not a federal standard): severity is the risk level's weight times the status factor; priority is severity divided by the effort the implementation cost implies; P1 at 50 or above, P2 at 30, P3 at 15, P4 above zero.
